calls.title: United Wheels + GrowthBook
calls.summary: United Wheels is currently not conducting active A/B tests, relying instead on post-launch data reviews, with an aim to implement structured experimentation aligned with its migration to Shopify. Key discussions included setting benchmarks prior to migration and managing multiple brands centrally. GrowthBook was positioned as a suitable experimentation platform, offering features like end-to-end experiment tracking, feature flagging, and flexible metric creation. The operational benefits highlighted included templates for consistent metrics and a visual editor for easy experimentation. Due to budget constraints, United Wheels plans to start with the open source version of GrowthBook, while recognizing the need for future scaling and internal evaluations.
calls.keywords: A/B testing, experimentation platform, warehouse-native, feature flags, open source, GrowthBook
